user_query: I'm organizing a team-building event for my company, and I want to create a positive and fun environment. Can you suggest some joke categories and a random chuck joke to lighten the mood? Additionally, I need some creative meme ideas, like a Sponge Bob meme and a Drake Likes and Hates meme, to incorporate humor into our team-building activities. Thank you for your help!

TaskList.description: Gather a list of joke categories that are appropriate for a team-building event.
Retrieve a random Chuck Norris joke from a joke API.
Generate creative ideas for a Sponge Bob meme that can resonate with the team.
Create ideas for a Drake Likes and Hates meme relevant to team dynamics.
Compile all gathered jokes, categories, and meme ideas into a presentation format for the team-building event.
